# Urban micro-scenes — catalogue

<!-- GENERATED by `node scripts/scene-catalog.mjs` from `src/microScenes/registry.ts`. Do not edit. -->

Short situations the city is already having when the player drives past. They are never missions, never
rewards, never prompts: two or three people, one conversation per appearance, at most one reaction to the car.

**8 scenes**, 87 recorded lines, 15 shared behaviour blocks.

## Shared behaviour blocks

A scene composes these by name; each is implemented exactly once in `src/microScenes/behaviors.ts`.

| Block | Used by | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idleConversation` | 3 scenes | A conversation already in progress: weight shifts, nods, hands on a point being made. |
| `alternateSpeakerGestures` | 7 scenes | The hands follow whoever is talking; everybody else answers in small movements. |
| `lookAtPlayer` | 7 scenes | A held look at the car, moving or not. |
| `lookAtPassingVehicle` | 6 scenes | A glance at a motor going past, let go once it has gone. |
| `stepAwayFromRoad` | 2 scenes | One step back off the kerb from something coming at them fast. |
| `passSmallProp` | 1 scene | A small prop handed on: one holder at a time, the receiver reaching for it. |
| `inspectObject` | 4 scenes | Bent over a bonnet or a table, pointing at what is wrong with it. |
| `coverTable` | 1 scene | Arms out over whatever is on the table, while the scene is alarmed. |
| `watchForPolice` | 3 scenes | An eye kept on the nearest police car. |
| `hideHeldObject` | 2 scenes | Whatever is in the hand goes away while the police are about. |
| `pauseWhenObserved` | 1 scene | Stop dead while the player sits there watching, and look back. |
| `dragLargeProp` | 1 scene | Two people hauling something heavy, in shoves. |
| `emitLightSmoke` | 2 scenes | A thin intermittent column of steam or smoke from the scene prop that makes it. |
| `playVehicleHazards` | 3 scenes | The double blink of a car parked where it should not be. |
| `resumeAfterDelay` | 3 scenes | Everything damped while the pause after a fright runs out. |

## Validation

No errors.

No warnings.

### Known gaps

- One female clone (`npc-femenino-1`). `npc-femenina-2` is voiced by it at a lower rate, as `npc-masculino-2` and
  `npc-policia-1` are by `npc-masculino-1`: honest placeholders, so two sides of a conversation are still two people.
- The `horn` reaction trigger has no input in this build — the game has no horn, and a micro-scene is not allowed
  to add one. `double-parking-argument`'s reply is written, generated and reachable from the debug tools.
- The anchor types `dark-corner`, `industrial-alley` and `dark-service-road` are supported but Bandido Metro's back
  lanes carry no measured pavement, so it lays none of them down today.
